description: Probably a court record in Hebrew. Late. The verso bears a potential filing note regarding the "case of Raḥamīm גרגיס (surname), in the matter of the bill of divorce" (ענין רחמים גרגיס ענין הגט). Damaged and faded. The recto and verso also mention: Avraham Levi, Avraham Ben-Zaytun, and Yosef Ha..l(?) Levi. Requires further examination. MCD.
description_he: כנראה פרוטוקול בית דין בעברית. מאוחר. פגום ודהוי.
